units.source_text: 男人去找水，在水槽旁边摸着什么就翻，摸到什么就抓。

en.t: The man went looking for water, groping around beside the water tank, overturning whatever he touched and grabbing whatever came to hand.

units.source_text: 所有化合物中，水是最单纯的化合物。

en.t: Of all compounds, water is the simplest compound.

units.source_text: 就像能从桌子的抽屉里拾到一分钱硬币那样，谁说一定找不到。

en.t: Just as one might pick up a one-cent coin from a desk drawer, who could say for certain that it could not be found?
Look, there was the smell of water.

units.source_text: 男人突然从水缸底下抓出一把湿漉漉的沙子，大口地塞满一嘴。

en.t: The man suddenly scooped a handful of soaking wet sand from beneath the water jar and stuffed his mouth full with a great gulp.

units.source_text: 一阵剧烈的恶心涌了上来。

en.t: A violent wave of nausea surged up.

units.source_text: 他弯下腰，胃里翻江倒海。

en.t: He bent over, his stomach churning violently.

units.source_text: 黄色的胃液和眼泪一起喷溢而出。

en.t: Yellow bile and tears sprayed out together.
